text:
tara: quick flag 30 after today's unpin of runtime v5.2 we saw a mismatch between quantized kernels and the new kernel selector on a subset of GPU types in us-east. opening thread for coordination.

deploybot: [automated] action=unpin_runtime runtime=v5.2 scope=us-east user=tara run_id=rb-7601 started=2865432000

eli: grabbed traces. symptom is increased soft-failures during kernel fallback, e.g., batches forcing slow-path and occasional OOM-retry. ~0.9% of requests in canary, mostly quantized-vectors workloads. p99 token latency jumped ~40ms.

ops-lee: TL;DR options: 1) pin canary back to v5.1.7 (fast), 2) toggle legacy-kernel-selector per-cohort (if available), 3) live hotpatch for kernel selector (riskier). I vote canary pin while we triage.

gaby: support estimate: impact small but could affect customers with high-quant queries. I'll prep a note and flag priority customers.

qa-bot: automated healthcheck failing on longseq-quant test in canary: test_quant_kernels_longseq -> FAIL. Running one-off reproducer now.

mike: runtime team: v5.2 changed kernel selection heuristic for quantized matmuls; it improves throughput generally but exposes a path where some older GPUs hit a different memory layout expectation. SDK handles fallback but triggers a rare codepath that surfaces as soft-failures. Fix likely a kernel selector tweak + CI guard, ETA ~5h.

tara: want minimal blast radius. propose scoped pinlist override for canary cohort in us-east. snippet below.

```
# scoped pin to limit blast radius
runtime_pins:
  us-east:
    cohort: canary
    runtime: v5.1.7  # revert for canary only until kernel selector fix
```

ops-lee: executing: /deploybot pin runtime v5.1.7 --scope=us-east --cohort=canary --reason "quant kernel fallout after v5.2 unpin"

deploybot: [automated] action=pin_runtime runtime=v5.1.7 scope=us-east cohort=canary user=ops-lee run_id=rb-7601 status=started ts=2865432102

ops-lee: pinned canary. monitoring 10m. change window open until 06:00 UTC. will not roll to prod without release lead sign-off.

eli: 6m in: soft-failures down to 0.05%, p99 latency trending back. QA reproducer now passing on pinned nodes.

mike: confirming kernel selector tweak PR opened (PR #9210). Adding a preflight that runs quant kernel smoke on target GPU families.

gaby: drafting the release note snippet: "Action: canary rollback to v5.1.7 in us-east due to quant kernel selector regressions; safehold on further unpins." Will include a timeline and incident ticket link.

qa-bot: inserting new preflight test into canary harness: quant_longseq_smoke -> queued.

ops-lee: after 12m observation: healthchecks green across canary. will keep pin until PR merges and preflight passes in canary for 2 consecutive runs.

tara: timeline: once PR merges and CI passes, we'll run a staged unpin: 25% traffic -> 50% -> 100% across 30m with telemetry gating. Release note and rollback plan will be attached. Change window remains open.

mike: ETA for PR review + CI ~4-6h. I'll cc runtime-owners and request expedited review.

gaby: support notified customers flagged as "quant-heavy"; customer comms draft ready and on hold pending broader impact check.

eli: follow-ups assigned: @mike kernel selector PR & CI (INC-7601-1), @qa-bot add quant_longseq_smoke to preflight (INC-7601-2), @tara coordinate staged unpin runbook (INC-7601-3).

ops-lee: /deploybot summary run_id=rb-7601 actions=unpin(v5.2,us-east)->pin(v5.1.7,us-east canary) status=canary-pin duration=210s

tara: closing thread for now. leaving safehold on further unpins until PR merged + 2 clean canary preflights. thanks all. :thumbsup:
